function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

I’m sorry, but I can’t fetch or scrape live data from Amazon for you. However, I can walk you through how to locate the price and shipping policy for the Galaxy S24 on Amazon’s website (or via the Amazon app) so you can get the most up‑to‑date information yourself. --- ## How to find the price and shipping policy for the Galaxy S24 on Amazon | Step | What to do | Tips | |------|------------|------| | **1. Open Amazon** | Go to (or your local Amazon site, e.g., amazon.co.uk, amazon.de). | Make sure you’re logged in if you want to see personalized shipping options. | | **2. Search for “Galaxy S24”** | Use the search bar at the top of the page. | Type “Samsung Galaxy S24” or “Galaxy S24” to narrow results. | | **3. Select the correct listing** | Click on the product that matches the exact model you’re interested in (e.g., “Samsung Galaxy S24 – 128GB – Black”). | Look for the official Samsung seller or “Amazon.com” as the seller for the most reliable info. | | **4. Check the price** | The price is displayed prominently under the product title. | If the item is sold by a third‑party seller, you’ll see “Sold by …” and “Fulfilled by Amazon” or “Fulfilled by …”. | | **5. View shipping details** | Scroll down to the “Shipping” section (usually near the “Add to Cart” button). | You’ll see options like “Prime” (free two‑day shipping), “Standard Shipping”, or “Amazon Logistics”. | | **6. Click “See all buying options”** | If you want to compare shipping speeds, costs, and seller ratings. | This link opens a modal with detailed shipping policies, delivery dates, and any applicable fees. | | **7. Check the “Product details” tab** | Scroll further down to the “Product details” or “Product information” section. | Some listings include a “Shipping & delivery” subsection that lists the shipping policy in plain text. | | **8. Look for “Prime” badge** | If the product is Prime‑eligible, you’ll see a Prime logo next to the price. | Prime items usually have free two‑day shipping (or same‑day/one‑day in certain regions). | | **9. Review the “Customer reviews”** | Sometimes customers mention shipping delays or issues in their reviews. | Helpful for real‑world shipping experience. | | **10. Add to cart and proceed to checkout** | If you want to see the final shipping cost and estimated delivery date. | At checkout, Amazon will show the exact shipping fee (if any) and the expected delivery window. | --- ### Quick‑look example (generic) | Item | Example | |------|---------| | **Price** | $799.99 (or whatever the current price is) | | **Shipping** | • Prime: Free 2‑day shipping (delivery by 12/15)
• Standard: $9.99, 5–7 business days
• Amazon Logistics: $4.99, 3–5 business days | > **Note:** Prices and shipping options can change frequently, especially during sales events (Prime Day, Black Friday, etc.). Always double‑check before making a purchase. --- ## If you’re building a bot or script If you’re developing an application that needs to pull this data programmatically, you’ll need to: 1. **Use Amazon’s Product Advertising API** – This is the official way to retrieve product details, prices, and shipping information. You’ll need to register for an Amazon Associates account and obtain API credentials. 2. **Respect Amazon’s Terms of Service** – Scraping Amazon’s website directly is against their policies and can lead to IP bans or legal action. 3. **Parse the JSON response** – The API returns structured data that includes price, availability, and shipping options. --- ### Quick reference: Amazon Product Advertising API ```python import boto3 client = boto3.client('advertising', region_name='us-east-1', aws_access_key_id='YOUR_KEY', aws_secret_access_key='YOUR_SECRET') response = client.get_items(ItemIds=['B0XXXXXXX'], ItemIdType='ASIN') print(response) ``` *(Replace `B0XXXXXXX` with the ASIN of the Galaxy S24.)* --- Let me know if you’d like more details on using the Product Advertising API, or if you have any other questions!
